theorem mvcc.genAdv_genPut (atRev : w64) (g g' : mvcc.Gen) (rev : mvcc.Rev) (hc : sint.Z atRev <
    sint.Z rev.main) : mvcc.genAdv atRev g (mvcc.genPut g' rev) = mvcc.genAdv atRev g g'

def mvcc.cutGen (c : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) : mvcc.Gen :=
  if g.revs ≠ [] ∧ mvcc.genWalk g.revs (mvcc.pAbove c) ≠ -1 then
    { ver := g.ver, created := g.created, revs := List.drop (mvcc.genWalk g.revs (mvcc.pAbove c)).toNat g.revs }
  else g

theorem mvcc.crevN_mono {c c' : Int} (h : c ≤ c') : mvcc.crevN c ≤ mvcc.crevN c'

def mvcc.EvOrd (log : mvcc.Log) : Prop :=
  List.Pairwise mvcc.Rev.lt (List.map mvcc.Ev.rev (mvcc.evsOf log)) ∧
    ∀ (e : mvcc.Ev),
      e ∈ mvcc.evsOf log →
        0 ≤ sint.Z e.rev.main ∧
          sint.Z e.rev.main < ↑(List.length log) ∧
            0 ≤ sint.Z e.rev.sub ∧
              ∃ cs, log[BitVec.toNat e.rev.main]? = some cs ∧ cs[BitVec.toNat e.rev.sub]? = some e.change

theorem mvcc.kiCompact_kiPut {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (c : w64) (rev : mvcc.Rev)
    (hc : sint.Z c < sint.Z rev.main) : mvcc.kiCompact c (mvcc.kiPut ki rev) = mvcc.kiPut
    (mvcc.kiCompact c ki) rev

theorem mvcc.evsOfRev_mem (m : Nat) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (e : mvcc.Ev) (he : e ∈ mvcc.evsOfRev m
    cs) : ∃ i, i < cs.length ∧ e.rev = { main := W64 ↑m, sub := W64 ↑i } ∧ cs[i]? = some e.change

def mvcc.compactGenIdx (atRev : w64) : List mvcc.Gen → Nat :=
  List.brecOn x✝ (mvcc.compactGenIdx._f atRev)

theorem mvcc.kiCompact_gens (c : w64) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : (mvcc.kiCompact c ki).gens = List.drop
    (mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens) (ki.gens.set (mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens) (mvcc.cutGen c
    (ki.gens.getD (mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens) mvcc.Gen.empty)))

def mvcc.IdxCRep (cmax : Int) (evs : List mvcc.Ev) (idx : mvcc.IndexM) : Prop :=
  List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx ∧
    ∀ (k : GoString), ∃ c, -1 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ cmax ∧ mvcc.idxGet idx k = mvcc.kiCompactO c (mvcc.kiOfKey evs k)

theorem mvcc.named_not_del (log : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB log) (c : Int) (hc0 : -1 ≤ c) (k :
    GoString) (atRev : w64) (hca : c ≤ sint.Z atRev) (r : mvcc.Rev) (cr v : w64) (hget : mvcc.kiGet
    (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k) atRev = some (r, cr, v)) (t : Bool) : ¬mvcc.KeyDel log c
    (mvcc.revBytes r t)

theorem mvcc.kiCompact_neg_S {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hs : mvcc.KiS ki) : mvcc.kiCompact (W64 (-1)) ki
    = ki

theorem mvcc.genAdv_ge {atRev : w64} {g : mvcc.Gen} (g' : mvcc.Gen) (h : sint.Z atRev < mvcc.tombZ
    g) : mvcc.genAdv atRev g g' = false

theorem mvcc.kiCompact_kiCompact (log : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB log) (k : GoString) (c c' : Int)
    (hc0 : -1 ≤ c) (h : c ≤ c') (hc' : c' < 2 ^ 63) : mvcc.kiCompact (W64 c') (mvcc.kiCompact (W64
    c) (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k)) = mvcc.kiCompact (W64 c') (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log)
    k)

theorem mvcc.dropSet_length {α : Type} (G : List α) (gi : Nat) (x : α) : (List.drop gi (G.set gi
    x)).length = G.length - gi

def mvcc.kiAvail (atRev : w64) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : Option mvcc.Rev :=
  have g := ki.gens.getD (mvcc.compactGenIdx atRev ki.gens) mvcc.Gen.empty;
  have ri := mvcc.genWalk g.revs (mvcc.pAbove atRev);
  if ri = -1 then none else some (g.revs.getD ri.toNat mvcc.Rev.zero)

def mvcc.tombZ (g : mvcc.Gen) : Int :=
  sint.Z (g.revs.getLastD mvcc.Rev.zero).main

theorem mvcc.kiCompact_lastEmpty (log : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB log) (k : GoString) (c : Int) (hc0
    : -1 ≤ c) (hc : c < 2 ^ 63) : mvcc.kiLastEmpty (mvcc.kiCompact (W64 c) (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf
    log) k)) = mvcc.kiLastEmpty (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k)

theorem mvcc.genAdv_put_pair {G : List mvcc.Gen} (hne : G ≠ []) (c : w64) (rev : mvcc.Rev) (hc :
    sint.Z c < sint.Z rev.main) (j : Nat) (hj : j + 1 < G.length) : mvcc.genAdv c ((G.dropLast ++
    [mvcc.genPut (G.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty) rev]).getD j mvcc.Gen.empty) ((G.dropLast ++
    [mvcc.genPut (G.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty) rev]).getD (j + 1) mvcc.Gen.empty) = mvcc.genAdv c
    (G.getD j mvcc.Gen.empty) (G.getD (j + 1) mvcc.Gen.empty)

theorem mvcc.compactGenIdx_appendEmpty {G : List mvcc.Gen} (hne : G ≠ []) (c : w64) (hlast :
    ¬mvcc.tombZ (G.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty) < sint.Z c) : mvcc.compactGenIdx c (G ++
    [mvcc.Gen.empty]) = mvcc.compactGenIdx c G

def mvcc.crevN (c : Int) : Nat :=
  (c + 1).toNat

theorem mvcc.genWalk_drop {revs : List mvcc.Rev} {p : mvcc.Rev → Bool} {d : Nat} (hd : ↑d ≤
    mvcc.genWalk revs p) : mvcc.genWalk (List.drop d revs) p = mvcc.genWalk revs p - ↑d

theorem mvcc.headD_drop (l : List mvcc.Rev) (j : Nat) (hj : j < l.length) : (List.drop j l).headD
    mvcc.Rev.zero = l[j]

def mvcc.kiCompact (atRev : w64) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  have gi := mvcc.compactGenIdx atRev ki.gens;
  have g := ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty;
  have ri := mvcc.genWalk g.revs (mvcc.pAbove atRev);
  have g' :=
    if g.revs ≠ [] ∧ ri ≠ -1 then { ver := g.ver, created := g.created, revs := List.drop ri.toNat g.revs } else g;
  { modified := ki.modified, gens := List.drop gi (ki.gens.set gi g') }

theorem mvcc.kiFindGenAux_zero (gens : List mvcc.Gen) (r : w64) : mvcc.kiFindGenAux gens r 0 = none

theorem mvcc.getElem?_dropLast_append {α : Type} (G : List α) (x : α) (h : G ≠ []) (i : Nat) :
    (G.dropLast ++ [x])[i]? = if i + 1 < G.length then G[i]? else if i + 1 = G.length then some x
    else none

theorem mvcc.dropSet_getD0 {α : Type} (G : List α) (gi : Nat) (x d : α) (h : gi < G.length) :
    (List.drop gi (G.set gi x)).getD 0 d = x

    (h : mvcc.IdxCRep cmax (mvcc.evsOf log) idx) (atRev : w64) (hc : cmax ≤ sint.Z atRev) (k e :
    GoString) : mvcc.rangeAt idx k e atRev = mvcc.rangeAt (mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf log)) k e atRev

    (m - gi) ((List.drop gi (G.set gi x)).set (m - gi) y) = List.drop m (G.set m y)

    (mvcc.kiCompact c ki).gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty = if mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens + 1 =
    ki.gens.length then mvcc.cutGen c (ki.gens.getD (mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens) mvcc.Gen.empty)
    else ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty

    mvcc.LogB log

theorem mvcc.genWalk_spec (revs : List mvcc.Rev) (p : mvcc.Rev → Bool) : (mvcc.genWalk revs p = -1 ∧
    ∀ (r : mvcc.Rev), r ∈ revs → p r = true) ∨ ∃ j hj, mvcc.genWalk revs p = ↑j ∧ p revs[j] = false
    ∧ ∀ (k : Nat) (hk : k < revs.length), j < k → p revs[k] = true

    e.change = mvcc.Change.del k

theorem mvcc.cutGen_cases (c : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) : mvcc.cutGen c g = g ∨ ∃ j hj, mvcc.genWalk
    g.revs (mvcc.pAbove c) = ↑j ∧ sint.Z g.revs[j].main ≤ sint.Z c ∧ (mvcc.cutGen c g).revs =
    List.drop j g.revs ∧ ∀ (k : Nat) (hk : k < g.revs.length), j < k → sint.Z c < sint.Z
    g.revs[k].main

def mvcc.KiEvs (evs : List mvcc.Ev) (k : GoString) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i p : Nat) (g : mvcc.Gen) (r : mvcc.Rev),
    ki.gens[i]? = some g →
      g.revs[p]? = some r →
        ∃ e, e ∈ evs ∧ e.rev = r ∧ e.key = k ∧ (e.tomb = true ↔ i + 1 < ki.gens.length ∧ p + 1 = g.revs.length)

theorem mvcc.evsOf_ord (log : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.LogB log → mvcc.EvOrd log

theorem mvcc.IdxCRep.kiAt (log : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB log) {cmax : Int} {idx : mvcc.IndexM} (h
    : mvcc.IdxCRep cmax (mvcc.evsOf log) idx) (atRev : w64) (hc : cmax ≤ sint.Z atRev) (k :
    GoString) : mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiAt idx k) atRev = mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k)
    atRev

    mvcc.tombZ g2) : mvcc.genAdv atRev g1 g' = mvcc.genAdv atRev g2 g'

    cmax ∧ mvcc.kiIsEmpty (mvcc.kiCompact (W64 c) (mvcc.kiOfKey evs k)) = true

    x)).getD (j + 1) d = G.getD (gi + j + 1) d

    (mvcc.kiRevs (mvcc.kiOfKey evs k)).Sublist (List.map mvcc.Ev.rev evs) ∧ mvcc.KiEvs evs k
    (mvcc.kiOfKey evs k)

    mvcc.IdxCRep cmax evs idx) (hle : cmax ≤ cmax') : mvcc.IdxCRep cmax' evs idx

theorem mvcc.getD_append_default {α : Type} (l : List α) (d : α) (i : Nat) : (l ++ [d]).getD i d =
    l.getD i d

def mvcc.genAdv (atRev : w64) (g g' : mvcc.Gen) : Bool :=
  decide (mvcc.tombZ g < sint.Z atRev) || decide (mvcc.tombZ g = sint.Z atRev) && mvcc.genRecreatedAt atRev g'

theorem mvcc.kiAvail_kiCompact_S {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (c c' : w64) (hcc :
    sint.Z c ≤ sint.Z c') : mvcc.kiAvail c' (mvcc.kiCompact c ki) = mvcc.kiAvail c' ki

def mvcc.genRecreatedAt (atRev : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) : Bool :=
  match g.revs with
  | [] => false
  | r :: tail => decide (sint.Z r.main = sint.Z atRev)

theorem mvcc.kiAvail_fold (c : w64) (k : GoString) (B : List mvcc.Ev) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) :
    mvcc.KiWf ki → (∀ (e : mvcc.Ev), e ∈ B → sint.Z c < sint.Z e.rev.main) → mvcc.kiAvail c
    (mvcc.kiFold ki B k) = mvcc.kiAvail c ki

theorem mvcc.KeyDel_prefix (log log' : mvcc.Log) (hpre : log <+: log') (hb' : mvcc.LogB log') (c :
    Int) (hc0 : -1 ≤ c) (hc : c < ↑(List.length log)) (key : GoString) : mvcc.KeyDel log' c key ↔
    mvcc.KeyDel log c key

theorem mvcc.compactGenIdx_eq (atRev : w64) (G : List mvcc.Gen) (gi : Nat) : gi < G.length → (∀ (j :
    Nat), j < gi → mvcc.genAdv atRev (G.getD j mvcc.Gen.empty) (G.getD (j + 1) mvcc.Gen.empty) =
    true) → gi + 1 = G.length ∨ mvcc.genAdv atRev (G.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty) (G.getD (gi + 1)
    mvcc.Gen.empty) = false → mvcc.compactGenIdx atRev G = gi

theorem mvcc.kiCompact_appendEmpty {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hne : ki.gens ≠ []) (c : w64) (hlast :
    ¬mvcc.tombZ (ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty) < sint.Z c) : mvcc.kiCompact c { modified :=
    ki.modified, gens := ki.gens ++ [mvcc.Gen.empty] } = have __src := mvcc.kiCompact c ki; {
    modified := __src.modified, gens := (mvcc.kiCompact c ki).gens ++ [mvcc.Gen.empty] }

theorem mvcc.Rev.lt_main_le {a b : mvcc.Rev} (h : a.lt b) : sint.Z a.main ≤ sint.Z b.main

theorem mvcc.compactGenIdx_put {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (c : w64) (rev : mvcc.Rev)
    (hc : sint.Z c < sint.Z rev.main) : mvcc.compactGenIdx c (ki.gens.dropLast ++ [mvcc.genPut
    (ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty) rev]) = mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens

theorem mvcc.cutGen_revs_ne (c : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) : (mvcc.cutGen c g).revs = [] ↔ g.revs = []

theorem mvcc.revBytes_rev_inj {a b : mvcc.Rev} {ta tb : Bool} (h : mvcc.revBytes a ta =
    mvcc.revBytes b tb) : a = b

theorem mvcc.genRecreatedAt_genPut (atRev : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) (rev : mvcc.Rev) (hc : sint.Z atRev
    < sint.Z rev.main) : mvcc.genRecreatedAt atRev (mvcc.genPut g rev) = mvcc.genRecreatedAt atRev g

theorem mvcc.IdxCRep.nil {cmax : Int} (h : -1 ≤ cmax) : mvcc.IdxCRep cmax [] []

theorem mvcc.KiS.mem_nonneg {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hs : mvcc.KiS ki) {i : Nat} (hi : i <
    ki.gens.length) {r : mvcc.Rev} (hr : r ∈ (ki.gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty).revs) : 0 ≤ sint.Z
    r.main

def mvcc.LogB (log : mvcc.Log) : Prop :=
  List.length log < 2 ^ 63 ∧ ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63

def mvcc.kiCompactO (c : Int) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : Option mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  if mvcc.kiIsEmpty (mvcc.kiCompact (W64 c) ki) = true then none else some (mvcc.kiCompact (W64 c) ki)

theorem mvcc.genWalk_pAbove_spec (revs : List mvcc.Rev) (c : w64) : (mvcc.genWalk revs (mvcc.pAbove
    c) = -1 ∧ ∀ (r : mvcc.Rev), r ∈ revs → sint.Z c < sint.Z r.main) ∨ ∃ j hj, mvcc.genWalk revs
    (mvcc.pAbove c) = ↑j ∧ sint.Z revs[j].main ≤ sint.Z c ∧ ∀ (k : Nat) (hk : k < revs.length), j <
    k → sint.Z c < sint.Z revs[k].main

theorem mvcc.kiCompact_lastEmpty_S {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (c : w64) :
    mvcc.kiLastEmpty (mvcc.kiCompact c ki) = mvcc.kiLastEmpty ki

theorem mvcc.kiCompact_kiTombstone {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (c : w64) (rev :
    mvcc.Rev) (hc : sint.Z c < sint.Z rev.main) : mvcc.kiCompact c (mvcc.kiTombstone ki rev) =
    mvcc.kiTombstone (mvcc.kiCompact c ki) rev

def mvcc.NoDelPutAt (log : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change) (i j : Nat) (k v : GoString) (l : w64),
    0 ≤ c →
      log[c.toNat]? = some cs → i < j → cs[i]? = some (mvcc.Change.del k) → cs[j]? = some (mvcc.Change.put k v l) → False

theorem mvcc.kiGet_kiCompact_S {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hs : mvcc.KiS ki) (c a : w64) (hca : sint.Z c ≤
    sint.Z a) : mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiCompact c ki) a = mvcc.kiGet ki a

theorem mvcc.KiEvs.mono {evs evs' : List mvcc.Ev} {k : GoString} {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (h :
    mvcc.KiEvs evs k ki) (hsub : ∀ (e : mvcc.Ev), e ∈ evs → e ∈ evs') : mvcc.KiEvs evs' k ki

theorem mvcc.genAdv_of_lt {atRev : w64} {g : mvcc.Gen} (g' : mvcc.Gen) (h : mvcc.tombZ g < sint.Z
    atRev) : mvcc.genAdv atRev g g' = true

theorem mvcc.kiAvail_kiCompact (log : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB log) (k : GoString) (c c' : Int)
    (hc0 : -1 ≤ c) (h : c ≤ c') (hc' : c' < 2 ^ 63) : mvcc.kiAvail (W64 c') (mvcc.kiCompact (W64 c)
    (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k)) = mvcc.kiAvail (W64 c') (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k)

theorem mvcc.compactGenIdx_before_le (atRev : w64) (G : List mvcc.Gen) (j : Nat) (h : j <
    mvcc.compactGenIdx atRev G) : mvcc.tombZ (G.getD j mvcc.Gen.empty) ≤ sint.Z atRev

theorem mvcc.genAdv_mono {c c' : w64} {g g' : mvcc.Gen} (hcc : sint.Z c ≤ sint.Z c') (h :
    mvcc.genAdv c g g' = true) : mvcc.genAdv c' g g' = true

theorem mvcc.KeyDel_neg {log : mvcc.Log} {c : Int} {key : GoString} (h : c < 0) : ¬mvcc.KeyDel log c
    key

theorem mvcc.dropSet_set0 {α : Type} (G : List α) (gi : Nat) (x y : α) (h : gi < G.length) :
    (List.drop gi (G.set gi x)).set 0 y = List.drop gi (G.set gi y)

theorem mvcc.compactGenIdx_before (atRev : w64) (G : List mvcc.Gen) (j : Nat) : j <
    mvcc.compactGenIdx atRev G → mvcc.genAdv atRev (G.getD j mvcc.Gen.empty) (G.getD (j + 1)
    mvcc.Gen.empty) = true

theorem mvcc.IdxCRep.step (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (x : mvcc.Change) (hb :
    mvcc.LogB (ilog ++ [pend ++ [x]])) {cmax : Int} {idx : mvcc.IndexM} (hcmax : cmax <
    ↑(List.length ilog)) (h : mvcc.IdxCRep cmax (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])) idx) : mvcc.IdxCRep
    cmax (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend ++ [x]])) (mvcc.idxApply idx (mvcc.evOfChange (List.length ilog)
    pend.length x))

theorem mvcc.dropSet_dropLast_append {α : Type} (G : List α) (gi : Nat) (w y : α) (hgi : gi + 1 <
    G.length) : List.drop gi ((G.dropLast ++ [y]).set gi w) = (List.drop gi (G.set gi w)).dropLast
    ++ [y]

theorem mvcc.genWalk_ge {revs : List mvcc.Rev} {p : mvcc.Rev → Bool} {j : Nat} (hj : j <
    revs.length) (hp : p revs[j] = false) : ↑j ≤ mvcc.genWalk revs p

theorem mvcc.kiFindGenAux_spec {gens : List mvcc.Gen} {a : w64} (fuel gx : Nat) : mvcc.kiFindGenAux
    gens a fuel = some gx → gx < fuel ∧ (gens.getD gx mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ [] ∧ ¬(gx ≠ gens.length
    - 1 ∧ sint.Z ((gens.getD gx mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.getLastD mvcc.Rev.zero).main ≤ sint.Z a) ∧
    sint.Z ((gens.getD gx mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.headD mvcc.Rev.zero).main ≤ sint.Z a

theorem mvcc.kiRevs_kiApply {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (e : mvcc.Ev) : mvcc.kiRevs
    (mvcc.kiApply ki e) = mvcc.kiRevs ki ∨ mvcc.kiRevs (mvcc.kiApply ki e) = mvcc.kiRevs ki ++
    [e.rev]

theorem mvcc.findAux_compact {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hs : mvcc.KiS ki) (c a : w64) (hca : sint.Z c ≤
    sint.Z a) (j : Nat) : j < ki.gens.length - mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens → mvcc.kiFindGenAux
    (mvcc.kiCompact c ki).gens a (j + 1) = Option.map (fun x => x - mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens)
    (mvcc.kiFindGenAux ki.gens a (mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens + j + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : Nat),
    mvcc.kiFindGenAux ki.gens a (mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens + j + 1) = some x → mvcc.compactGenIdx
    c ki.gens ≤ x

theorem mvcc.IdxCRep.get_some {cmax : Int} {evs : List mvcc.Ev} {idx : mvcc.IndexM} (h :
    mvcc.IdxCRep cmax evs idx) {k : GoString} {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hg : mvcc.idxGet idx k = some
    ki) : ∃ c, -1 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ cmax ∧ ki = mvcc.kiCompact (W64 c) (mvcc.kiOfKey evs k) ∧ mvcc.kiIsEmpty
    ki = false

theorem mvcc.kiCompact_empty_lastEmpty (log : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB log) (k : GoString) (c :
    Int) (hc0 : -1 ≤ c) (hc : c < 2 ^ 63) (he : mvcc.kiIsEmpty (mvcc.kiCompact (W64 c) (mvcc.kiOfKey
    (mvcc.evsOf log) k)) = true) : mvcc.kiLastEmpty (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k) = true

theorem mvcc.sorted_main_le {revs : List mvcc.Rev} (hs : List.Pairwise mvcc.Rev.lt revs) {i j : Nat}
    (hij : i ≤ j) (hj : j < revs.length) : sint.Z revs[i].main ≤ sint.Z revs[j].main

theorem mvcc.kiIsEmpty_lastEmpty {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (h : mvcc.kiIsEmpty ki = true) :
    mvcc.kiLastEmpty ki = true

structure mvcc.KiS (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : Prop where
  wf : mvcc.KiWf ki
  sorted : List.Pairwise mvcc.Rev.lt (mvcc.kiRevs ki)
  nonneg : 0 ≤ sint.Z r.main

theorem mvcc.kiCompact_modified (c : w64) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : (mvcc.kiCompact c ki).modified =
    ki.modified

theorem mvcc.cutGen_cutGen (c c' : w64) (hcc : sint.Z c ≤ sint.Z c') (g : mvcc.Gen) : mvcc.cutGen c'
    (mvcc.cutGen c g) = mvcc.cutGen c' g

theorem mvcc.cutGen_last (c : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) : (mvcc.cutGen c g).revs.getLastD mvcc.Rev.zero =
    g.revs.getLastD mvcc.Rev.zero

theorem mvcc.kiCompact_kiPut_fresh {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (c : w64) (rev :
    mvcc.Rev) (hc : sint.Z c < sint.Z rev.main) (he : mvcc.kiIsEmpty (mvcc.kiCompact c ki) = true) :
    mvcc.kiCompact c (mvcc.kiPut ki rev) = mvcc.kiPut mvcc.KeyIndex.fresh rev

theorem mvcc.kiGet_of_kiCompact_empty (log : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB log) (k : GoString) (c atRev
    : w64) (hc : sint.Z c ≤ sint.Z atRev) (he : mvcc.kiIsEmpty (mvcc.kiCompact c (mvcc.kiOfKey
    (mvcc.evsOf log) k)) = true) : mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k) atRev = none

theorem mvcc.crevN_le {c c' : Int} (h0 : -1 ≤ c) (h0' : -1 ≤ c') (h : mvcc.crevN c ≤ mvcc.crevN c')
    : c ≤ c'

theorem mvcc.kiGet_kiCompact (log : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB log) (k : GoString) (c atRev : w64)
    (hc : sint.Z c ≤ sint.Z atRev) : mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiCompact c (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k))
    atRev = mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k) atRev

theorem mvcc.genGet_cutGen (c a : w64) (hca : sint.Z c ≤ sint.Z a) (g : mvcc.Gen) : mvcc.genGet
    (mvcc.cutGen c g) a = mvcc.genGet g a

theorem mvcc.NoDelPutAt_neg {log : mvcc.Log} {c : Int} (h : c < 0) : mvcc.NoDelPutAt log c

theorem mvcc.cutGen_created (c : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) : (mvcc.cutGen c g).created = g.created

theorem mvcc.cutGen_genPut (c : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) (rev : mvcc.Rev) (hc : sint.Z c < sint.Z
    rev.main) : mvcc.cutGen c (mvcc.genPut g rev) = mvcc.genPut (mvcc.cutGen c g) rev

theorem mvcc.genAdv_empty (atRev : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) : mvcc.genAdv atRev g mvcc.Gen.empty = decide
    (mvcc.tombZ g < sint.Z atRev)

theorem mvcc.idxGet_some_mem {idx : mvcc.IndexM} (hs : List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx) {k :
    GoString} {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (h : mvcc.idxGet idx k = some ki) : (k, ki) ∈ idx

theorem mvcc.kiCompact_neg (log : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB log) (k : GoString) : mvcc.kiCompact
    (W64 (-1)) (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k) = mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k

theorem mvcc.NoDelPutAt_prefix {log log' : mvcc.Log} (hpre : log <+: log') {c : Int} (hc : c <
    ↑(List.length log)) : mvcc.NoDelPutAt log' c ↔ mvcc.NoDelPutAt log c

def mvcc.KeyDel (log : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) (key : GoString) : Prop :=
  c < ↑(List.length log) ∧ ∃ r t, key = mvcc.revBytes r t ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z r.main ∧ sint.Z r.main ≤ c ∧ ¬mvcc.keepAt log c r

theorem mvcc.kiIsEmpty_kiTombstone (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (rev : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.kiIsEmpty
    (mvcc.kiTombstone ki rev) = false

theorem mvcc.change_of_not_tomb {e : mvcc.Ev} {k : GoString} (hk : e.key = k) (ht : e.tomb = false)
    : ∃ v l, e.change = mvcc.Change.put k v l

theorem mvcc.kiAvail_kiApply {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (c : w64) (e : mvcc.Ev) (hc :
    sint.Z c < sint.Z e.rev.main) : mvcc.kiAvail c (mvcc.kiApply ki e) = mvcc.kiAvail c ki

theorem mvcc.KeyIndex.ext' {a b : mvcc.KeyIndex} (h1 : a.modified = b.modified) (h2 : a.gens =
    b.gens) : a = b

theorem mvcc.KiS.cross {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hs : mvcc.KiS ki) {i j : Nat} (hij : i < j) (hj : j <
    ki.gens.length) {a b : mvcc.Rev} (ha : a ∈ (ki.gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty).revs) (hb : b ∈
    (ki.gens.getD j mvcc.Gen.empty).revs) : a.lt b

theorem mvcc.KiEvs.apply {evs : List mvcc.Ev} {k : GoString} {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf
    ki) (h : mvcc.KiEvs evs k ki) (e : mvcc.Ev) (hk : e.key = k) : mvcc.KiEvs (evs ++ [e]) k
    (mvcc.kiApply ki e)

theorem mvcc.cutGen_tombZ (c : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) : mvcc.tombZ (mvcc.cutGen c g) = mvcc.tombZ g

theorem mvcc.cutGen_ver (c : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) : (mvcc.cutGen c g).ver = g.ver

theorem mvcc.kiCompactO_step (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (x : mvcc.Change) (hb :
    mvcc.LogB (ilog ++ [pend ++ [x]])) (k : GoString) (c : Int) (hc0 : -1 ≤ c) (hc : c <
    ↑(List.length ilog)) : mvcc.kiCompactO c (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend ++ [x]])) k) =
    have ev := mvcc.evOfChange (List.length ilog) pend.length x; if ev.key = k then match
    mvcc.kiCompactO c (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])) k) with | some ki' => if ev.tomb =
    true then if mvcc.kiLastEmpty ki' = true then some ki' else some (mvcc.kiTombstone ki' ev.rev)
    else some (mvcc.kiPut ki' ev.rev) | none => if ev.tomb = true then none else some (mvcc.kiPut
    mvcc.KeyIndex.fresh ev.rev) else mvcc.kiCompactO c (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend]))
    k)

theorem mvcc.kiAvail_kiPut {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (c : w64) (rev : mvcc.Rev) (hc
    : sint.Z c < sint.Z rev.main) : mvcc.kiAvail c (mvcc.kiPut ki rev) = mvcc.kiAvail c ki

theorem mvcc.genWalk_lt (revs : List mvcc.Rev) (p : mvcc.Rev → Bool) : mvcc.genWalk revs p <
    ↑revs.length

theorem mvcc.crevN_neg : mvcc.crevN (-1) = 0

theorem mvcc.compactGenIdx_stop (atRev : w64) (G : List mvcc.Gen) : G ≠ [] → mvcc.compactGenIdx
    atRev G + 1 = G.length ∨ mvcc.genAdv atRev (G.getD (mvcc.compactGenIdx atRev G) mvcc.Gen.empty)
    (G.getD (mvcc.compactGenIdx atRev G + 1) mvcc.Gen.empty) = false

def mvcc.compactRevIdx (atRev : w64) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : Int :=
  mvcc.genWalk (ki.gens.getD (mvcc.compactGenIdx atRev ki.gens) mvcc.Gen.empty).revs (mvcc.pAbove atRev)

def mvcc.kiKeep (atRev : w64) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : Option mvcc.Rev :=
  if mvcc.kiIsEmpty ki = true then none
  else
    have gi := mvcc.compactGenIdx atRev ki.gens;
    have g := ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty;
    have ri := mvcc.genWalk g.revs (mvcc.pAbove atRev);
    if ri = -1 then none
    else
      if g.revs ≠ [] ∧ ri = ↑(g.revs.length - 1) ∧ gi ≠ ki.gens.length - 1 then none
      else some (g.revs.getD ri.toNat mvcc.Rev.zero)

theorem mvcc.compactGenIdx.eq_def (atRev : w64) (x✝ : List mvcc.Gen) : mvcc.compactGenIdx atRev x✝ =
    match x✝ with | [] => 0 | [head] => 0 | g :: g' :: gs => if mvcc.genAdv atRev g g' = true then
    mvcc.compactGenIdx atRev (g' :: gs) + 1 else 0

theorem mvcc.genAdv_le {atRev : w64} {g g' : mvcc.Gen} (h : mvcc.genAdv atRev g g' = true) :
    mvcc.tombZ g ≤ sint.Z atRev

theorem mvcc.KiS.gen_sorted {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hs : mvcc.KiS ki) {i : Nat} (hi : i <
    ki.gens.length) : List.Pairwise mvcc.Rev.lt (ki.gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty).revs

theorem mvcc.compactGenIdx_lt (atRev : w64) (G : List mvcc.Gen) : G ≠ [] → mvcc.compactGenIdx atRev
    G < G.length

theorem mvcc.kiOfKey_KiS (log : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB log) (k : GoString) : mvcc.KiS
    (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k)
